name: SmartPrint (Smart Print)
summary: Polish budget-to-mid filament brand (Smart Print) that two Central European retailers attribute to Imagine s.c. of Cholerzyn near Krakow. Broad PLA-variant range plus PETG, ABS/ABS+, ASA, TPU, PLA-CF and PA12-CF15 on 1 kg spools at roughly EUR 10-16/kg; there is no official brand website.

oem_relationships.notes: Suspected owner and manufacturer. 3dstisk.com names Imagine s.c. (Dominika Pamula, Krzysztof Pamula; Cholerzyn 501, 32-060 Liszki, Poland) as the manufacturer, and htmodel.sk titles listings 'Imagine filament ... | Smart Print'. Two consistent retailer sources; not verified against a company registry or an official brand site.
Retailers name Imagine s.c. (Cholerzyn, Poland) as the SmartPrint maker, and SimplyPrint links the Professional LAB shop to the same company. No official statement.

product_lines.name: Meta PLA
product_lines.notes: Marketing name; the chemistry difference from standard PLA is not documented.

product_lines.name: Silk PLA (single, dual and tri-colour)
product_lines.notes: Dual and tri-colour versions are co-extruded silk, mapped to pla-silk.

product_lines.name: TPU
product_lines.notes: Shore hardness not stated in the notes.

additional_notes: Professional LAB (ABS+ lines, listed by htmodel.sk as 'Imagine filament ABS+ ... | Professional Lab') is a suspected sister line from the same Imagine s.c. and has its own catalog entry (professional-lab); the shared ownership is suspected, not confirmed. Not to be confused with other, unrelated businesses named SmartPrint. No official website found; sold through resellers (3dstisk.com, htmodel.sk, empik.com). Retail pricing is about EUR 10-16/kg, at the budget/mid boundary. SpoolmanDB PR lists 21 products.

provenance.conflicts: Imagine s.c. as owner/manufacturer comes from two retailers only, with no registry check and no official brand site. Polish manufacturing rests on the retailer calling Imagine the 'Polish manufacturer'.
